scope: Fresh source-bound combined camera/CC isolated fixture; staged layout bytes unchanged. Full consumer qualification remains open.

input_binding.note: run.json captures source, lock, exact footprint and macro hashes; staged macro matches its captured input. Publication/import and full-board integration need fresh consumer validation.

limitations: The owned 0.25 mm C-positive to VIN lead carries the switched load and input-bypass current. Qualify actual load/inrush current, copper thickness, voltage drop and temperature rise. The control_supply classification is not a rating for full load-switch current. Host owns VOUT/output bypass, ON/CT/QOD, IC ground and complete load/return loop.
Fixture acceptance does not test every allowed rotation or the complete consumer.

Native DRC excludes courtyards, silkscreen, solder-mask bridges, library/schematic parity, length/skew/differential rules and footprint-forbidding keepouts. Placement and source contract checks are separate.
Two raw explicit-ground observations are reconciled by native fills; final native board has no opens or violations.
Current, thermal, assembly, supply integrity and EMI qualification remain open.
